howToRead: Each category is reported on its own. Rates are of the cases run. A category marked not run has no number here.

categories.title: Simple application generation

providers.Gemini Nano: not tried: the device model is not assumed able to build apps (docs/07 section 4.5)

categories.note: Text and voice requests the golden set labels simple. Templates build them with no model; two cases are too vague or need the cloud and were not built.

categories.title: Medium application generation

providers.Gemini Nano: not tried: the device model is not assumed able to build apps (docs/07 section 4.5)

categories.note: Text and voice requests labelled medium.

categories.title: Complex application generation

providers.Gemini Nano: not tried: the device model is not assumed able to build apps (docs/07 section 4.5)

categories.note: Text and voice requests labelled complex.

categories.title: Sketch understanding

providers.Gemini Nano: not tried: the device model is not assumed able to build apps (docs/07 section 4.5)

categories.note: Synthetic sketches (stamps and text). Hand-drawn photographs are not in the set.

categories.title: Image field extraction
categories.note: Needs real photographs of slips and receipts. The set holds synthetic placeholders that are never sent to a model, and the device model is not assumed to read images (capabilities.ts).

categories.title: Voice action interpretation
categories.note: Spoken commands the app's own phrases do not match; five more commands of the 28 never reach a model because the phrases answer them.

categories.title: Small edits
categories.note: No case set yet. The deterministic edit parser answers most small edits with no model; the device path has tests but no benchmark.

categories.title: Structural edits
categories.note: No case set yet. Structural edits always go to the cloud; they are covered by unit tests only.

categories.title: Classification
categories.note: The complexity tie-break between two levels, over the labelled request sets (84 cases). The same gate also covers AI steps that classify text.

categories.title: Summarisation
categories.note: Invented order-book notes of one or two sentences, summarised in 25 words or fewer.

categories.title: Translation
categories.note: English to Spanish and Japanese, the only languages besides English the Chrome Prompt API speaks. Hindi and the other app languages always go to the cloud.

categories.title: AI-block verification
categories.note: One classify step, model-written test inputs. Open-ended steps (summarise, translate) are graded by a cloud judge and are not in this run.
